Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 12450 of 2023
Applicant :- Smt. Mithlesh Verma

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Sectt. Lko
Counsel for Applicant :- Ajeet Kumar
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.
1.
Supplementary affidavit filed on behalf of the applicant is taken on record.

2. Heard Sri Ajeet Kumar, the learned counsel for the applicant as well as Ms. Ankita Tripathi the learned AGA for the State and perused the records.
2.

The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.
716 of 2022, under Sections 409, 420 IPC, Police Station Kotwali Nagar, District Barabanki.

3. The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of an FIR lodged on 20.07.2022 against six named persons, including the applicant, alleging that the informant had made some investments in Lifelong Multi State Cooperative Society and Sangarsh Total Solution Infra Built Pvt. Ltd. but upon maturity neither his amount was repaid nor the sale deed was executed in his favour.

entities.text: Sangarsh Total Solution Infra Built Pvt. Ltd.
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: The applicant has been implicated in the present case subsequently, as she is also a Director of the body in which the investment was made.

Smt. Mithlesh Verma vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home ... on 19 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/164562868/

entities.text: Mithlesh Verma vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The applicant's involvement in total 41 cases of similar nature has been disclosed in para 21 of the affidavit filed in support of the bail application, in five of which she has bee granted bail.

5. Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the fact that the applicant has already been granted bail in five other cases of similar nature and that she is languishing in jail since 24.11.2022, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail in the present case also.
6. Accordingly, this bail application stands allowed.
